ars_elemancy.page1.cinder_focus: This Заклинание focus is attuned to the school of Огонь. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified и discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other Стихийный schools. The major focus will also grant Заклинание Damage II while the wearer is on Огонь или in lava.
ars_elemancy.page2.cinder_focus: This focus empowers Ignite to inflict Магия Burn. This effect allows flare to inflict damage и spread even on Огонь resistant mobs и let Магия pierce through part of the enemy armor, but will also make Земля damage less effective. Summon Steed will be changed to summon a rideable Strider. Ignite + Evaporate combo will sublimate Ice.
ars_elemancy.page1.tempest_focus: This Заклинание focus is attuned to the school of Вода. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified и discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other Стихийный schools. The major focus will also grant Мана Regen I while the wearer is wet или Мана Regen II и Dolphin Grace while swimming.
ars_elemancy.page2.tempest_focus: This focus empowers Freeze, adding Freezing buildups to the target и eventually Frozen status for a short time, stopping the target from healing. If used after Conjure Вода, the conjured Вода will become ice. Summon Steed will be changed to summon a rideable Dolphin, time your jumps out of the Вода to build up Скорость. All Drowning damage against Вода creatures will be converted to Магия.

The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other Стихийный schools. The major focus will also grant Мана Regen I while the wearer stands over Y 200 или is under the shocked effect.
ars_elemancy.page2.vapor_focus: This focus empowers Launch, changing it to apply Levitate when augmented with ExtendTime. It also empower Cut, giving chances to drop an head или skull if it deals the killing blow.
ars_elemancy.page1.silt_focus: This Заклинание focus is attuned to the school of Земля. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified и discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other Стихийный schools. The major focus also grants Мана Regen I while the wearer stand under Y 0.
ars_elemancy.page2.silt_focus: This focus empowers Poison Spores и Grow, dealing damage to undead with a chance of spawning a spore blossom, и Gravity, when augmented with Sensitive, changing it to create a gravity field that pull entities towards its center (filter-compatible), also offers knockback resistance и boosts natural и instant healing by 1.5.

ars_elemancy.page.armor_set.wip: Note: Since the Armor Rework requires a lot of assets work, the light и heavy Стихийный armors variants won't be ready for 1.19, so the 'medium' Стихийный armors can be crafted will all three types. Upgrading will keep enchants и threads, but requires the base armor to be at tier 3.
